title: Independent compact-context typed path-routing pilot
description: A frozen 32-session comparison of four unseen exact/parameterized routing and browser assignments in Parley, Python, TypeScript, and Rust, using the pre-corpus 176-token Parley v0.5.7 path-response card.

validated_transport.channel: Two protected mode-0600 POSIX FIFOs carry bounded request and public-feedback messages; only the parent evaluator binds loopback.
validated_transport.threat_boundary: The transport is a measurement-integrity mechanism for command-constrained agents, not an isolation boundary against a deliberately hostile workspace process.

validated_exact_build_freeze.positive_control: Canonical manifest/lock survives native release and wasm32 release builds byte-for-byte.
validated_exact_build_freeze.negative_control: A displaced root block passes cargo metadata --locked --offline; cargo build --release returns zero and rewrites it; post-command hashes reject the build.
validated_exact_build_freeze.required_integration: Reference validation and measured evaluation must hash every protected/read-only input immediately after each exact build command for every language, in addition to final workspace integrity.

scratch_space_control.preflight_timing: Resolve disjoint work, journal, and attempt roots and require the full four-worker budget before journal initialization or any measured cell start.
scratch_space_control.evidence_boundary: The disposable work root and durable journal/attempt roots must be distinct real directories with no equal, ancestor, or descendant relationship.
scratch_space_control.cleanup_order: Persist the complete finished journal and external parent attempts before removing that journal's exact real immediate-child workspace through cleanup_finished_workspace.
scratch_space_control.resume_policy: On resume, seal every started unfinished cell as a permanent failure before reclaiming only workspaces certified by finished records; run only never-started cells.
scratch_space_control.failure_policy: Preflight, boundary, cleanup, or renewed capacity failure stops scheduling new cells, remains an execution-integrity failure after any cell starts, and never authorizes a rerun.
scratch_space_control.calibration_rule: Clean-room harness validation must measure peak per-cell scratch use. Revision 2 may increase, but never lower, the frozen reserve or per-worker budget before the first measured session.

matrix.derivation: 4 tasks x 4 languages x 1 agent configuration x 2 replicates

parley.stack: Generated native HTTP/JSON server with checked whole-segment path parameters, dynamic response envelopes, and generated browser WebAssembly
parley.agent_context: Frozen 176-token v0.5.7 compact path-response card used alone and included in measured input tokens.

python.stack: FastAPI 0.141.1, Uvicorn 0.52.1, Pydantic 2.13.4, and a counted browser JavaScript application module

rust.stack: Axum 0.8.9, Tokio 1.53.1, Tower HTTP 0.7.0, Serde 1.0.229, serde_json 1.0.151, and a scalar WebAssembly export

scaffold_protocol.purpose: Supply stable language-appropriate transport, build, and browser wiring so the measured assignment is application implementation or repair rather than framework installation.
scaffold_protocol.editable: Task-specific route handlers, response records, browser score modules, and application manifests required by each language.
scaffold_protocol.read_only: Dependency locks, generic launch adapters, shared static shell, frozen contract, source printer, generated check client, public check wrapper, and benchmark configuration.
scaffold_protocol.source_visibility: The first shell command prints every editable and visibly read-only source/context file exactly once. Direct reconnaissance or reading protected case/configuration files is forbidden.
scaffold_protocol.dependency_setup: Pinned dependencies are installed or fetched before measured sessions. Each parent evaluation uses only the frozen local dependency store; network time is never part of a cell.
scaffold_protocol.reference_validation: Before measurement, isolated reference applications for all 16 task/language pairs must run the exact measured builds under post-command hash checks and pass all 160 named public/hidden HTTP path/status/JSON/header and browser cases. Every maintenance seed must build, fail its public parameterized case, and pass after changing only the predeclared route-handler root file.
scaffold_protocol.rust_lockfile: Generate Cargo.lock canonically from the final study-047 manifest. Run native and wasm32 release builds locked and offline under immediate post-command hash checks, then preserve the reviewed lock hash in every Rust workspace.
scaffold_protocol.symmetry: Every language receives the same English contract and semantic cases. Framework-specific source and configuration may differ, but no language receives a hidden expected value or repair.

session_protocol.runner: A new iteration-047 runner creates one isolated workspace, external attempt directory, immutable journal entry, and fresh ephemeral Codex thread per cell.
session_protocol.tool_policy: Disable user configuration, repository rules, plugins, apps, browser-use, computer-use, and multi-agent delegation. Use workspace-write with approval never and network disabled.
session_protocol.command_policy: The first shell command must be exactly ./sources and occur once. Every later shell command must be exactly ./check. At least one and at most eight ./check commands are permitted.
session_protocol.public_feedback: Each ./check request is evaluated by the parent and records build output plus all public HTTP path/status/JSON/custom-header and real-Chromium verdicts, then returns only bounded public feedback.
session_protocol.public_execution_requirement: Every completed public attempt must execute all five public cases, including four HTTP cases and the browser case. A build failure may short-circuit cases but remains a failed attempt; zero semantic execution cannot pass.
session_protocol.hidden_judgment: After the agent exits, the parent separately rebuilds and executes all withheld HTTP path/status/JSON/custom-header and browser cases. Hidden inputs and values never enter the workspace or public transport.
session_protocol.attempt_capture: Preserve every parent-owned public attempt, source snapshot, file hash, changed-file list, command event, agent message, diagnostic, stdout/stderr, elapsed time, thread ID, and reported token count.
session_protocol.integrity: Hash all protected/read-only files immediately after every exact build and at cell finalization; reject unexpected files and symlinks; compare FIFO device/inode/type/mode/owner; revalidate frozen repository and toolchain provenance; require one start/finish journal record per cell; preserve the initial and renewed scratch checks without binding observed free bytes into resume identity; persist evidence and measured workspace bytes before bounded per-cell cleanup.
session_protocol.resume_policy: A started cell without a finished record becomes a permanent interruption failure; only never-started cells may execute.
session_protocol.failure_policy: Timeouts, interruptions, agent errors, nonzero exits, build failures, case failures, protocol violations, checker/FIFO/read-only integrity failures, missing source, unexpected files, scratch-boundary violations, low-space events after start, and cleanup failures are failures and remain in the complete result.
session_protocol.domain_judgment: The parent sends frozen raw paths without pre-decoding or validating captured segments. Routing, exact priority, once-decoding, safety rejection, authorization, and positive-decimal validation are application-stack responsibilities.

requirements: bind every new and transitive execution file by SHA-256
validate 16 task/language reference applications in clean rooms
validate all 160 named public/hidden cases including decoded captures
prove all eight language-specific maintenance roots with built negative controls
calibrate peak workspace use within the frozen scratch allowance
pass parent-owned FIFO, HTTP, header, malformed-path, and Chromium smoke
prove live-to-persisted JSON equality for paths, path parameters, and headers
execution_freeze.prohibition: No measured session may start until revision 2 is committed with zero measured sessions and every requirement passing.

metrics.correctness: Exact hidden HTTP route/status/JSON/error/custom-header and real-browser results, overall and by task, kind, language, and replicate.
metrics.first_check: Whether the first parent-owned public build and all five public cases pass, with HTTP and browser execution counts retained.
metrics.repairs: Number of later ./check attempts after the first, with every parent attempt retained outside the workspace.
metrics.tokens: Complete reported Codex input, cached input, uncached input, output, reasoning output, and input-plus-output totals. Primary efficiency uses complete input-plus-output tokens per assignment.
metrics.elapsed: Monotonic wall time for the whole fresh session, including parent-owned public builds and repairs but excluding dependency installation.
metrics.maintainability: Changed editable files, rough token edit size, and whether maintenance patches touch exactly the predeclared defect-root file set.
metrics.source: Final and seed UTF-8 bytes, physical lines, rough tokens, o200k_base tokens, and per-file SHA-256, reported descriptively rather than substituted for session tokens.
metrics.cross_target: Valid decoded path integer/browser equality for the shared score plus successful Chromium execution; routing, invalid-path, authorization, and header branches remain separately exact.

primary_gate.execution_integrity: All 32 cells must finish exactly once with unique thread IDs, one journal start/finish, compliant commands, durable evidence, intact protected inputs, required HTTP/browser execution, and no runner, scratch, or cleanup error.
primary_gate.correctness: Parley must pass 100% of hidden HTTP and browser cases, and its assignment success rate must be no lower than every baseline overall and within both implementation and maintenance tasks.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley's first-public-check assignment success rate must be no lower than the highest baseline rate overall and within each task kind.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley's median complete input-plus-output tokens per assignment must be no higher than the lowest baseline median overall.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley's median complete-session elapsed seconds must be no higher than the lowest baseline median overall.
primary_gate.maintainability: Every hidden-correct Parley maintenance assignment must change exactly its predeclared root file set, and its exact-root rate must be no lower than every baseline.
primary_gate.verdict: All six conditions must hold for strict unseen path-routing agent parity and efficiency. Report every condition independently when the gate fails.

secondary_analysis: Report complete distributions and paired task/replicate cells; never replace the primary result with a successful or repair-free subset.
Report implementation and maintenance separately, including exact repair-root quality and public/hidden disagreement classes.
Report public-attempt and semantic case counts so build-only feedback cannot appear as a passing check.
Report frozen context, manifest, scaffold, final-source, and complete-session token counts without substituting source size for session cost.
Compare study 046 only as mechanism history; never pool its tasks, tokens, or timing with study 047.
Treat two replicates as pilot evidence: show paired observations and avoid population-level certainty claims.
interpretation_boundary: The study covers four small synthetic path-routing plus browser contracts, one model ID, one reasoning setting, two replicates, and one frozen toolchain environment.
Scaffolds test application work, not dependency discovery, deployment, load, databases, accessibility, or production operations.
Header comparisons test deterministic request decisions, not general identity or policy-system security.
A deterministic scalar export in real Chromium is a cross-target check, not a general user-interface evaluation.
Synthetic route-handler defects cover only the declared capture-use failures and do not estimate production-defect distributions.
Even a fully passing gate cannot prove universal language superiority; it supports only the frozen comparative claim.
A failed strict gate cannot be repaired by same-corpus language, context, prompt, task, runner, threshold, or metric tuning.
implementation_rule: Corpus semantics were frozen before this revision. Scaffold generation, dependency preparation, clean-room validation, orchestration evidence, and every transitive execution hash must be committed in revision 2 before measurement.
change_rule: Task semantics have been immutable since corpus commit 32017e311379d007481c7c52a06f652a76830aea. From revision 1 onward, no context, metric, threshold, model, reasoning setting, replicate count, or primary gate may change based on validation or output. An objective harness defect may be corrected only before measurement in a documented zero-session amendment preserving semantic hashes. Scratch budgets may increase but not decrease.
stop_rule: Run every frozen cell once and publish the complete positive, mixed, negative, or invalid result without same-corpus optimization or rerun. Any later product change requires a corpus outside iteration 047.
